name: Clockify
description: Clockify is a time-tracking and timesheet platform for logging work, reporting billable hours, managing attendance, planning capacity, approving timesheets, tracking expenses, and invoicing.
best_for: Best suited to freelancers and teams that need time tracking first, with optional billing, approvals, scheduling, productivity monitoring, GPS, and enterprise administration on higher plans.
features: Timer, manual timesheet entry, and calendar view for logging time
Auto-tracker that turns app and website usage into time entries
Kiosk clock-in for shared-device attendance tracking
Detailed reports on activity, rates, earnings, and project budgets

alternatives.name: Toggl Track
alternatives.description: A time-tracking platform with timers, background activity, project profitability, workload reporting, and integrations.
alternatives.best_for: Teams prioritizing polished time tracking and profitability analysis.

alternatives.name: Hubstaff
alternatives.description: A workforce management and time-tracking platform with activity monitoring, scheduling, GPS, and payroll integrations.
alternatives.best_for: Distributed teams that need workforce visibility, location tracking, and payroll workflows.

alternatives.name: Harvest
alternatives.description: A time-tracking and invoicing platform focused on project budgets, billable hours, expenses, and client billing.
alternatives.best_for: Agencies, consultancies, and freelancers connecting tracked time directly to project budgets and invoices.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Free for up to 5 users with unlimited time tracking and core timer/timesheet features.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Billed annually; $6.99/seat/month on monthly billing. Adds billing, invoicing, approvals, time off, attendance, and related controls.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Billed annually; $9.99/seat/month on monthly billing. Adds scheduling, forecasting, expenses, profitability, GPS, and productivity controls.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Billed annually; $14.99/seat/month on monthly billing. Adds SSO, audit log, custom subdomain, and additional administrative controls.

cons: Clockify's Free plan is currently capped at 5 users, so larger teams need a paid plan even if they only need basic time tracking.
Every active or invited user on a paid plan occupies a paid seat; annual pricing requires prepaying the seat for the year.
Features such as invoicing and approvals start on Standard, while scheduling, expenses, GPS tracking, and profitability controls require Pro or higher.

faq.question: Is Clockify still free for unlimited users?
faq.answer: No. Clockify's current pricing page lists the Free plan at $0 for up to 5 users. It still includes unlimited time tracking, but teams above 5 users need a paid plan.

faq.question: How much do Clockify paid plans cost?
faq.answer: On annual billing, Basic is $3.99 per seat per month, Standard $5.49, Pro $7.99, and Enterprise $11.99. Monthly billing is higher at $4.99, $6.99, $9.99, and $14.99 respectively.

faq.question: Does Clockify offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. Clockify offers a 7-day trial of Pro features without requiring a credit card.

faq.question: What should I compare before choosing Clockify?
faq.answer: Check your team size first, then decide whether you need only time tracking or also approvals, invoicing, attendance, scheduling, profitability, expenses, GPS, SSO, or audit logs. Those capabilities are split across different paid tiers.
